correctness.rationale: Every legal word decomposes uniquely into constant-orientation runs 1,2,3 whose distinct successive letters form edges of H_q; terminal run length1 enforces symmetric stack join. Analytic Perron transfer matrix S(z) H_q determines growth and exponential concentration. Tilting a run by its letter occurrence count and differentiating the simple positive Perron pole shows mean letter proportion v_a² (normalized eigenvector). For 8 angles equitable quotient [[2,2],[2,1]] gives rho=(3+sqrt17)/2 and v_P²=(17+sqrt17)/136; 12 angles form C_12^3, six-regular with v_a²=1/12. Chernoff bounds and union bound give strict alpha< or > dichotomy, and 1/12<0.1<alpha_8. Independently rebuilt angle graphs and finite counts; critical alpha and balance not claimed.
